name: db-backup
description: A forgotten Debian 11 database backup box: weak default logins, nightly pg_dump jobs, a deploy user with an API config and a customer export. Breadcrumb target of the /.env decoy.

Nightly PostgreSQL dumps live in /srv/backups. Do not store anything else here.

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
source /home/deploy/backup.env
STAMP=$(date +%F)
pg_dump "$DATABASE_URL" | gzip > /srv/backups/nightly_${STAMP}.sql.gz
find /srv/backups -name 'nightly_*.sql.gz' -mtime +${RETENTION_DAYS} -delete

# placeholder: overwritten at start-up with the generated honeytoken
BACKUP_DIR=/srv/backups
RETENTION_DAYS=14

cd /srv/backups
ls -la
pg_dump -h db-01 -U svc_reporting shop_prod | gzip > nightly.sql.gz
cat ~/.config/acme.json
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $(jq -r .api_key ~/.config/acme.json)" https://api.acme-internal.example/v1/health
exit
